title: Card
description: work/papers/<id>/card.json. The card's readout settled by whoever built the page: the expert, from the full text, or the quick agent, which writes {"readout": null} when the scout's number is not printed in the title or abstract. Input to publish; never published as a file.

readout.description: The readout taken from the brief's evidence table, which keeps its place in the paper. It replaces the scout's readout. null when the paper has no single headline number or the scout's number is not what the paper reports: the card then shows none.
